The '''Simocadia Royal family''' ruled the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Simocadia]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] the ruling Empress [[Sephani]] supported the Republic, while her son, prince [[Yojan]] had joined the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]]. Yojan died in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] when he sacrificed his life to stop the [[Ardana Shadex]] he unintentionally unleashed upon the Royal City.
